title: Market node mapping and fallback cost scenarios
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Objective: produce an operational "market node" map that correlates model availability, regional latency buckets, procurement triggers, and the estimated customer fallout and cost-to-fallback for high-value accounts. Outcome should be a deliverable playbook for Sales/CS and Engineering that: 1) identifies top-25 geographic+industry nodes where model supply shocks cause outsized customer risk, 2) quantifies fallback cost (latency, token-cost delta, infra delta) per node, and 3) prescribes automated routing + procurement triggers and escalation steps for resiliency.

Scope: public open-model supply and major commercial providers across NA/EU/APAC, Redwood-hosted vs Dedicated vs Private deployment options, and operational levers (quantization, batching, routing, dedicated commits). Excludes deep model architecture benchmarking; focus is availability, SLO hit probability under supply shock, and customer remediation choreography.

Deliverables:
- Market node map (CSV + geo-heatmap) with supply fragility score per node
- Fallback cost model (spreadsheet) for representative customer archetypes (startup-PLG, mid-market SaaS, enterprise-finserv)
- Playbook doc for Sales/CS with decision thresholds and automated routing policies to implement in Console
- One-pager for Execs summarizing top 5 risk nodes and recommended procurement triggers.

Why now: recent supplier throttling incidents in APAC and a mid-market churn signal tied to latency spikiness make this high priority for upcoming Dedicated contracts and enterprise renewals.
acceptance_criteria: Market node map exists as CSV and annotated heatmap with methodology notes
Fallback cost model provides per-customer archetype delta (latency, per-token cost, infra) and is reproducible
Playbook includes automated triggers (thresholds) and manual escalation steps; reviewed by Sales and SRE
Runbook prototypes (routing/quantization combo) validated in staging with two synthetic supply-shock scenarios
